_README: The 'Load worked example' payload for the contract builder in
It lives here as a real file, rather than inline in the page's
JavaScript, so that tests/contract_sketch_corpus.rs can compile it. A
demo button that ships broken is worse than no demo button: the first
thing anyone clicks would show a wall of findings about the example
rather than about anything they did.
Four blocks, chosen so all four stamp behaviours are visible at once:
profile        sourced, coverage complete  -> enum of 2
fundamentals   sourced, coverage partial   -> enum of 3
summary        narrative                   -> no stamp at all

blocks.name: profile

source.response_field: symbol, companyName, sector, price, marketCap, beta

blocks.why: FMP's /stable/profile returns every field of this block for a resolved ticker, or an empty array for a symbol it does not carry. Those are the only two outcomes, which is why the stamp admits exactly two verdicts.

blocks.name: fundamentals
blocks.why: Coverage is partial, and the distinction is load-bearing: individual members of this block are absent for whole classes of filer — free cash flow yield for a pre-revenue biotech. That is the tool answering and the field having no source, which is a third verdict.

blocks.name: assessment

source.from: the retrieved profile and fundamentals blocks, weighed against sector base rates

blocks.why: The load-bearing entry. Every number here is a judgement over the blocks above and can never be tool_verified however good those inputs were — two runs over one set of responses may legitimately disagree, which is what makes it not a retrieval.

blocks.name: summary
blocks.why: Prose for a human, and the field with the least protection: the one place a number the sourced blocks could not supply can reappear as a sentence. It must assert nothing the blocks above cannot support.
